intro: MaxTrax Oil is a targeted ayurvedic topical blend crafted for male wellness massage. Consistent use helps stimulate circulation, relax tissue, and enhance comfort, supporting overall confidence as part of a balanced lifestyle. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without greasy residue, making it convenient for day or night routines; results vary by individual and consistency. This is a cosmetic/ayurvedic topical product, not a medicine.

li: Ayurvedic massage oil formulated to support local circulation and vitality in men.
Helps improve tissue suppleness and comfort with regular massage; fast‑absorbing and non‑sticky.
Designed to complement fitness, nutrition, and lifestyle routines aimed at confidence and performance.
Precision dropper for hygienic, targeted application; easy to carry.
15 ml concentrated bottle suitable for daily use.
Clean and dry the area. Apply 2–4 drops; massage gently for 3–5 minutes until absorbed.
Use once or twice daily for at least 8–12 weeks; do not use on broken/irritated skin.
Patch test on inner arm before first use.
1 x MaxTrax Oil, 15 ml dropper bottle
Adult men seeking ayurvedic topical support for circulation, suppleness, and confidence.
External use only; avoid sensitive mucosal areas and eyes; wash hands after use. Discontinue if irritation occurs.
Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Store cool and dry, away from sunlight.
